name: White Ape Troll
_source: Monster Sheet (2 pages), AI/BP/Trait cards, Thick Skin back, Signature — owner scans 2026-11-15 (readings owner-confirmed); Clash Setup: Sunken Kingdom Codex p.50–51

footprint.rear: the two cells behind (R / eye = Rear + Blindspot)

basicAbilities.name: Unavoidable Knockback
basicAbilities.rule: Rulebook p.51: a Knight on the space the Boss ends its movement on suffers Crash and Unavoidable Knockback 4.

basicAbilities.name: Blindspot
basicAbilities.rule: The two cells behind are Blindspots.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.text: Start of Monster Round: Place the Thick Skin BP card on the top of the BP deck, unless it’s already there. When the Thick Skin BP card is wounded, place it next to the BP deck, and do not Escalate. If the Thick Skin BP card is on top of the BP deck and any effect would let you interact with the BP deck, ignore that interaction.

traits.name: Firstmen Guardians
traits.text:
Additional Setup: Place the Firstman Guardian Trait BP card on the leftmost space on the Mob track.
Firstmen Guardians are Mobs represented by a single Trait BP card. When you Spawn or kill a Firstman Guardian, do not Escalate or place any cards on the Wound Stack. If that Mob had the BP card on the Mob track, pass it the next Mob or, if there’s none, place it on the leftmost space. When Spawning (odd), place Firstmen Guardians on empty spaces adjacent to the Great Mangrove Terrain tiles, closest to the White Ape Troll until you reach the Firstmen Guardians Limit on the Clash Board:
Level 1–2: Firstmen Guardians Limit: 4.
Level 3: Firstmen Guardians Limit: 5. Level 4+: Firstmen Guardians Limit: 6.

Start of Monster Round: Spawn 1 new Firstman Guardian. Then, check which Firstman Guardian has the BP card on the Mob track. That Mob performs Coordinated Attack. Pass the BP card to the next Mob (if there’s any).
End of Monster Round: Each Firstman Guardian moves to the closest space adjacent to the White Ape Troll not occupied by another Firstman Guardian, in order from closest to furthest. If the targeted space is occupied by a Knight, that Knight suffers Crash and Unavoidable Knockback 2.

! The White Ape Troll has +1 To Hit [To Hit] for every Firstman Guardian adjacent to it. If there are 4+ Firstmen Guardians adjacent to the White Ape Troll, every Attack Roll against it is a Full Miss.

traits.name: Reinforcements Have Arrived
traits.text: Each time the White Ape Troll is dealt a Wound or you wound the Thick Skin BP card (a Double Wound is treated as 2 Wounds), place a Generic token on this Trait. When you finish resolving the current action, if there are 4 or more Generic tokens on this Trait, discard all Generic tokens and Spawn a Firstman Guardian. The Spawned Guardian performs Coordinated Attack. If no Guardian can Spawn due to the Limit, the next Guardian performs Coordinated Attack instead.

traits.name: Vantage Seeker
traits.text: Tree Climb: Move the White Ape Troll to the closest Great Mangrove Terrain tile, so that its base is fully placed on the Terrain tile.

traits.name: Strength in Numbers
traits.text: When a Firstman Guardian performs Coordinated Attack against you, lose additional -X [Vigor], where X is the number of other Firstmen Guardians on the Clash Board.

traits.name: Avenger of the Tribe
traits.text:
Each time a Firstman Guardian is killed, place a Generic token on this Trait. When you finish resolving the current action, if there are 5 Generic tokens on this Trait, discard all Generic tokens and resolve the top AI card.
Level 3: 4 Generic tokens instead.
Level 4+: 3 Generic tokens instead.

traits.name: We Are Legion
traits.text: Start of Monster Round: Spawn 2 new Firstmen Guardians instead.

traits.name: Unnerving Presence
traits.text: Knights no longer discard the Exposed Condition card after an Evasion Roll. When a Knight with the Exposed Condition card is attacked, one of the Evasion dice is an automatic hit.

clashSetup._source: Sunken Kingdom Codex p.50–51 (White Ape Troll Clash)
steps: Monster Positioning: Place the White Ape Troll on the designated space, then 2 Firstmen Warrior miniatures adjacent to it on the designated spaces (facing per arrows) — for this Clash they represent Firstmen Guardians.

Additional Setup: Place the Thick Skin BP card on top of the BP deck. Place the Coordinated Attack card and the Firstman Guardian BP card near the Monster Sheet (Firstmen Guardians: the Trait BP card goes on the leftmost Mob-track space).
notes: 지형 칸 위치는 코덱스 도식에서 읽음 (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)

rulings: Thick Skin wounded: set aside, no Wound/Escalation, gives 1 Reinforcements token; Strength in Numbers extra Vigor loss only on a hit; Avenger resolves the top AI card as an extra activation; Side Knockback direction is chosen by the player (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
"PUSHBACK 3 & ZONE ATTACK 1": the Troll turns to the Target (targeting line) and Pushes it back 3, then the Zone 1 Attack resolves against every Knight in Zone 1 (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
JUMP & ATTACK: the Troll is placed adjacent to the Target on the reachable position closest to it, without Crash or destroying Terrain (Jump, p.51) (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
LAND ON TOP (2x2): the Troll's base covers the Target's space (position closest to the Troll; ties → player); Knights under it are Displaced, the Target to a front space (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
MOVE & ATTACK ALL KNIGHTS IN PATH: every Knight the Troll moves through (Crash) plus the Target is attacked in turn; After Final Attack applies to the Target (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
Knockback X to the side: perpendicular to the Troll's facing; the Knight picks the side (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)

Tree Climb (Vantage Seeker): moves onto the closest Great Mangrove tile (base fully on it) before the Range Attack; with "cannot perform Range Attacks" (Bulky Biceps) the card resolves without the attack (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
Thick Skin wounded: set next to the BP deck — no Wound, no Escalation; it returns to the top of the BP deck at the Start of the next Monster Round (Regeneration)

Firstmen Guardians: Mobs sharing the single Firstman Guardian Trait BP (AT 4, To Hit 7+, Advanced Bypass); killing one adds no Wound and no Escalation; the Mob-track BP card passes to the next Guardian
Guardian Bonus Attack "once per round, per Knight": tracked per Knight per round
Reinforcements Have Arrived: the spawned Guardian performs Coordinated Attack; at the Limit, the Guardian holding the Trait BP performs it instead (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)

Owner reference sheet WAT v1.2 (2026-11-15): a failed attack on Thick Skin leaves it on top of the BP deck; the Guardian BP (AT 4) and Coordinated Attack gain the Troll's level AT / Vigor bonuses; End of Monster Round Guardians move in number order; attacking from the Blindspot gives +1 Precision
Routine Lil' Nap "Heal 1": remove the top card of the Wound Stack (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
